text: Yes, they say the owner is still in the hospital each time that I call.
15 different emails. They told me someone hacked into their system, and then stopped responding.
They responded stating that they had switched over payment processors and would be reissuing payments that were missed. I never heard anything else.
I was reprimanded for asking about the state of their finances, since I hadn't been paid since October.
They threatened me because I reported them to the Tampa Airport.
Online chat is always offline. The contact form creates an error and asks you to try again later.
I still get emails about new shops, so I'm assuming people still do jobs for them and just don't get paid.
A scheduler called to recruit me and promised the owner would pay her new recruits, despite the payment problems others reported.
Assured my concern was elevated to the payroll team. After that they stopped responding. The payroll team never reached out.
I called probably 35 times and emailed 15. Never responded.
Spoke with the owner directly and he said their payroll department would clear this up. That never happened. Now he does not return my calls.
